author: Exult
quote:
Breathtaking game. Genuinely one of the most beautiful games I have laid eyes on
There is something that most games miss these days and that is beautiful graphics with a unique art style. Not just generic models. But this game fixes that. It scratches that desire right on the head. Amazing story smooth gameplay and a beautiful world. Not much more you could want
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Exult
quote: After thirteen years they have managed to make five but worse. New mechanics which don't add anything or the game. Random bugs even after years of waiting. Story is mild. It just feels mediocre after all the hype
